violations.text: Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on the expo 1-door low boy cooler and prep unit #2 at the end of the cookline. Refrigerator door gaskets shall be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/23/2026

Prep unit #3 located on the cookline in the kitchen area was observed with ice being used a form of coolant and was not in good repair. Equipment shall be maintained in good repair. Establishment is not to use unit to store TCS food items until unit is repaired or replaced. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to prevent the accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2026

The presence of small flies is not controlled as evidenced by live activity in the bar area. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. Establishment is to work with pest control to create action plan. New Violation. Correct By: 05/06/2025

Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on prep units #2 & #3, the 2-door low boy at the end of the cookline, as well as the 1-door low boy refrigerator by the pass through. Refrigerator door gaskets shall be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/06/2025

The non-food contact surfaces of the refrigerator door gaskets on the bar coolers, kitchen refrigeration units, and the ventilation vents above the ware washing area have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to prevent the accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 05/06/2025
